target_customer: Teams deploying AI agents that take state changing actions such as refunds or updates
problem: Agents make costly mistakes, such as refunding without checking the order ID, and evals or observability find them only after the fact. Salus checks actions before they execute.
business_model: Usage based API and developer tooling (pricing not found)

founders.name: Vedant Singh
founders.background_notes: Described as an AI researcher on the YC page.

founders.name: Kevin Pan
education: Stanford, computer science (per YC launch post)
founders.background_notes: Surname from the YC launch post author line and a third party profile; the YC company page gives only Kevin.

competitors.name: Guardrails AI
competitors.what: Output validation framework for LLM applications

competitors.name: Lakera (Check Point)
competitors.what: Prompt injection and agent security runtime layer

competitors.name: NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails
competitors.what: Open source programmable guardrails for LLM apps

technical_complexity.rationale: Checks grounding of actions in tool outputs against written policies, plus PII, budget and loop protection, are standard engineering with hard evaluation parts. The company reports results on tau2-bench.

defensibility.rationale: Many guardrail products exist and agent platforms can add action checks; integration into agent loops gives limited lock in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Guardrail vendors and security firms already sold related products; Lakera was bought by Check Point. No acquisition of Salus recorded.

market_need_then: Companies shipping agents in 2026 report costly wrong actions, and many vendor comparisons list runtime action validation as a gap beyond content screening.

branding.name_origin: Salus is the Roman goddess of safety and well being, a general fact; no source says this is why the founders chose it.
branding.domain_note: Uses usesalus.ai with a use prefix, not an exact .com.

identity.logo: Text wordmark Salus with a trailing period, and a floral heart symbol in the footer
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and understated: Prevent. Repair. Prove.

brand_strength.rationale: Short meaningful name and consistent voice, but many unrelated Salus brands and trademarks exist and only aggregator coverage was found.

outcome_analysis: Salus is a two person Winter 2026 YC company selling runtime checks for AI agent actions. It is active, with no confirmed funding amount, and faces vendors and security firms already in guardrails. Nothing indicates an outcome yet, so the story is early.
notes: Funding unverified: VCBacked and EveryDev list 500K USD from YC dated 2026-01 (aggregators), while a StartupHub write-up says 4M USD from one source only; neither recorded as a round. Outcome search found no news. Salus Cloud 3.7M USD seed is a different company.
